articles.title: Z+ (abopflichtiger Inhalt); »Kleiner Regen« von Garth Greenwell: Dankbar und desinfiziert
articles.teaser: Gibt es morgen noch ein morgen? Garth Greenwell verwandelt die Klinik zum Roman.
articles.image_title:
»Kleiner Regen« von Garth Greenwell: BU: Der Amerikaner Garth Greenwell behandelt in seinem Roman »Kleiner Regen« unter anderem die Frage, wie es sich damit lebt, beinahe gestorben zu sein. ++++++++++
The writer Garth Greenwell, author of the new book "Cleanness," at his home in Iowa City, Iowa, Dec. 18, 2019. From the start, Greenwell said, his debut novel "What Belongs to You" and his follow-up "Cleanness" were intended to be "one project," though the world of his newer one is more expansive. (Mary Mathis/The New York Times)
